programs.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
programs.desc: In the summer of 2005, New Orleans was bustling with activity.Carefreeness was shattered by the specter of a powerful hurricane that formed in the Bahamas.After passing over the Gulf of Mexico, wind speeds exceeded 250 km/h.The cyclone reached the fifth, highest category.The delayed evacuation order led to a tragedy on a massive scale.Trapped residents had to prepare for the worst.Years later, the survivors will speak out.Their relationships are full of fear.They recall how they anxiously waited for the arrival of an element of terrifying force.
